verdict.rationale: The anthropics/skills repo ships an actual template/SKILL.md with placeholder text for the description (docs-29). The Agent Skills specification documents the required YAML frontmatter, including `name` and `description` fields and the description's length and content rules (docs-44, docs-17, docs-51). It also documents the directory layout (docs-66), and a skill-creator skill helps author new skills (docs-13, docs-30). A community user reports having defined skills 'with proper YAML headers' (comm-12), though their complaints concern triggering rather than authoring. Missing for 10: independent hands-on walkthrough of authoring from the template; the `name` field's constraints are not shown in the evidence.
